# Ankara
The city gave its name to the Angora wool shorn from Angora rabbits, the long-haired Angora goat (the source of mohair), and the Angora cat. ## Geography
Ankara shares its borders with Bolu and Çankırı in the north; Konya and Kırıkkale in the east.
